Performance • Panels are modeled as higher performance with 21% rated efficiency, 96% inverter Assumptions efficiency, 1.10 direct current/alternating current (DC/AC) ratio,14% system losses, and azimuth/tilt angles that vary by location. • Total panel area is modeled at 40% of the roof area for each model.
